startup.title: Kagerou could not start
startup.recover: Its data lives in {{dir}}. Deleting kagerou.sqlite3 there starts over with an empty app — the profiles and settings in it are lost.
startup.recoverNoDir: Deleting kagerou.sqlite3 from Kagerou's data folder starts over with an empty app — the profiles and settings in it are lost.

errors.storage: The app could not read or write its own data.
errors.notFound: That is not there any more — the list may be out of date.
errors.configInvalid: The proxy configuration could not be built. One of the VPNs may have a damaged key.
errors.coreFailed: The proxy core would not start.
errors.network: Nothing answered. Check the connection and the address.
errors.subscriptionInvalid: That address answered with something that is not a subscription.
errors.subscriptionRefused: The provider refused to hand the subscription to this app. Some providers serve only the apps on their own list.
errors.notASubscriptionUrl: A subscription address has to be an http or https link.
errors.notASubscription: That group is not a subscription, so there is nothing to refresh.
errors.activeProfileInUse: The VPN in use belongs to this subscription. Switch to another one or disconnect first.
errors.testRunInProgress: A test is already running. Wait for it or stop it first.
errors.lookupFailed: The location could not be looked up through the tunnel.
errors.fileWrite: The file could not be saved there.
errors.updateFailed: The update could not be downloaded or installed.
